source: Hand-picked by a team member in the species photo focus picker, 2026-10-05
note: x and y are percentages across and down the photo (0 to 100). The app uses them as CSS object-position so the chosen point stays visible when the photo is cropped to a square tile or a 4:3 picture. Species not listed stay centred. Loaded by backend/build_species_db.py into species_images.focus_x / focus_y (sort_order 1 only).
